task: Algebra::gcd fails when an argument is PHP_INT_MIN even though the gcd fits in an int. gcd(6, PHP_INT_MIN) throws TypeError instead of returning 2, and gcd(PHP_INT_MIN, 6) returns 2 only through a float-to-int cast that emits a "not representable as an int" warning. Every such pair whose gcd is representable should work without warnings, for example gcd(PHP_INT_MIN, 1) = 1, gcd(PHP_INT_MIN, 3298534883328) = 1099511627776 and gcd(4611686018427387904, PHP_INT_MIN) = 4611686018427387904, and extendedGcd and the arbitrary-precision gcd must agree with it.
